explication: My Translator is a Tauri desktop app that captures system and/or microphone audio, translates speech through Soniox, OpenAI Realtime, Qwen, or offline MLX, and presents results in an overlay. The main path runs from user audio selection through capture and engine-specific translation to the transcript UI; optional narration and session history are separate branches. README documents broad provider and UI capabilities, while sampled source confirms only some wiring, so unverified subsystem links are omitted. The graph focuses on runtime behavior, not build or setup machinery.
